kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجلوذ (form XIII)
# أَجْلَوِّذُ (ʔajlawwiḏu) /ʔad͡ʒ.law.wi.ðu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
# أَجْلَوِّذَ (ʔajlawwiḏa) /ʔad͡ʒ.law.wi.ða/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
# أَجْلَوِّذْ (ʔajlawwiḏ) /ʔad͡ʒ.law.wið/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْلَوَّذَ (ijlawwaḏa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
